page.notes: The small chapter numerals at the left edge of column 1 and column 2 are read from the scan and may be off. Only the first word of the first line of column 2 ("ofa") is doubtful; it is marked [?]. The printed "X." at the head is taken as the page number. Word-level transcription is from the scan, not from the Vulgate. The fold runs through column 1 at "filios Dei" and column 3 at "Attendite" and "Christi"; these are not printed marks.
